description: Find Perceptlayer endpoints for a website or kind of data. The catalogue has 1730 endpoints across 248 sources, so search before calling. Query with the site and the data you want, e.g. "amazon product reviews", "airbnb listing", "linkedin company", "google maps places", "zillow property". Returns compact matches: endpoint ID (pass it to get_endpoint or call_endpoint), name, HTTP method, credits per call (credits_max when the price depends on the call), tier ("restricted" endpoints need the account's restricted-endpoint terms accepted) and required parameters. Free; no API key needed.

query.description: Site and/or data wanted, in a few words, e.g. "tripadvisor hotel reviews".

vertical.description: Optional: only return endpoints in this vertical.

name: search_endpoints
title: Search data endpoints
